items.text: स्थानं प्रवेशो रूपं च लक्षं लक्षणमेव च उत्थापनं बोधनं च चक्रविश्राममेव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भूमिकागमनं चैव अन्तावस्था तथैव च विश्रामः परिणामश्च तथागमनमेव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इति त्रयोदशविधं शाक्तं विज्ञानमुत्तमम् सर्वेषु त्रिकशास्त्रेषु सूचितं शम्भुना स्वयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नाभ्यधो ऽङ्गुलाः पञ्च मेढ्रस्योर्ध्वाङ्गुलद्वयम् तन्मध्ये कन्दनामा च चक्रस्थानमिति स्मृतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्राणापाननिरोधेन मनस्तत्रैव निःक्षिपेत्सम्यग्वायुगतिं जित्वा यावन्मध्यगतां नयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एष प्रवेश इत्याहू रूपं वक्ष्यामि चाधुना शृङ्गाटकनिभं चक्रं षडरं चापरं ध्रुवम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दाडिमीकुसुमप्रख्यं कन्दं वै जातिलोहितमेतद्रूपं समाख्यातं तृतीयं चिन्तनात्मकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तन्मध्ये निक्षिपेच्चित्तं यावत्तत्र स्थिरीकृतम् त्यक्तरुद्धो यदा वायुस्तदा लक्षं विनिर्दिशेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कन्दचक्रस्य मध्यस्था त्वनाहतमयी कला अधऊर्ध्वे रेखासंयुक्ता भुजंगकुटिलाकृतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऊर्ध्वाधो ऽवस्थितावस्था सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभौ सत्यं विराजमाना सा सहस्रार्कसमप्रभा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तामेवालोकयेच् छक्तिं मनाक्कुम्भकवृत्तिना एतल्लक्षणमुद्दिष्टमुत्थापनमतः परम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: जुषद्रेचकवृत्त्या तु मन्त्रं चैव समुच्चरेत्प्रबुद्धां चिन्तयेच्छक्तिं दण्डवत्परमेश्वरीम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आधारमध्यादायाता सुषुम्नामार्गमाश्रिता उत्थापनं समाख्यातं बोधनं परतस्तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कन्दस्थो वेधयेन्नाभिं ततो हृत्स्थं पितामहम् कण्ठस्थमच्युतं साक्षाद्रुद्रं तालुतले स्थितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भ्रुवोर्मध्यगतं त्वीशं ब्रह्मद्वारे सदाशिवम् बोधयित्वा व्रजेदाशु पदं चानाश्रितं शिवम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एतद्बोधनमुद्दिष्टं चक्रविश्रामणं ततः स्वाभाविकं दलं दीप्तं द्रवं स्थिरनभोपमम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अमृतं शेखरं चैव शक्तिर्ब्रह्मा तथैव च बिन्दुनादं तथा प्रोक्तं चक्रद्वादशकं किल
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वेधयन्ती क्रमाच् छक्तिश्चक्रे चक्रे प्रतिक्षणम् विश्रमेत्सा महादेवी चक्रविश्राम उत्तमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: हृदयं कम्पते पूर्वं तालुकद्वारमेव च शिरश्च भ्रमते तस्य दृष्टिसंक्रान्तिलक्षणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकैकं भ्रमयत्यङ्गमङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसंधिषु घूर्णते हृदयं चास्य सम्यग्विद्याप्रभावतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यानि यानि विकाराणि अवस्था कुरुते सतः तेषु तेषु न भेतव्यं क्रीडति परमेश्वरी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अमृते सेयमुन्मत्ता विकारान् कुरुते बहून्मलत्रयविकारौ बहुजन्मसु यत्कृतम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: धुनोति समलान् पाशात्परशक्तिसमुत्थितान्भूमिकागमनं प्रोक्तमन्तावस्था तथोच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यत्संक्रान्तौ रोमहर्षो ऽस्रुपातो जृम्भारम्भो गद्गदा गीर्गिरो ऽन्तः ग्रन्थिस्फोटः स्पर्शदिव्यप्रहर्षो बिन्दुस्पन्दा नाभिकन्दात्स्फुरन्ति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अन्तावस्था समाख्याता विश्रामस्त्वधुनोच्यते नाभिचक्रविनिर्याता यदा शक्तिः प्रबुध्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदा त्वस्तमितं सर्वमक्षग्रामं बहिः स्थितम् यदा सा परमा शक्तिः सुलीना परमे पदे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदा न विन्दते किंचिद्विषयी विषयान्तरम् शिवे विश्राम्यते शक्तिस्तदा विश्राम उच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यत्र विश्रमणं शक्तेर्मनस्तत्र लयं व्रजेत्तदात्मा परमात्मत्वे ज्ञातव्यो निश्चितात्मभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शिवीभूतो भवत्यात्मा परिणामः स एव हि सदा स वर्षते दिव्यममृतं जन्तुजीवनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: चित्तं तत्र तु संधार्य पुनर्दैवी विशेत्तु सा तदा त्वागमनं प्रोक्तमेवं सम्यक्त्रयोदश
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
